frontend.meaning: Empty means same-origin /api via the canonical edge. A non-empty value is a development-only override.

api.description: NestJS API (private Cloud Run service / api-production compose container).

bff.description: NestJS BFF, the only public application origin (Cloud Run behind the load balancer / bff-production compose container).

worker.description: BullMQ worker + Nest scheduler (Cloud Run worker pool / worker-production compose container).

web.description: Static built web bundle served behind the edge; only Vite build-time env applies (VITE_BFF_BASE_URL, tracked in the frontend field, not entries).

edge.description: nginx edge (HTTPS termination locally; External HTTPS Load Balancer + Cloud Armor on GCP). Reads BFF_MAX_BODY_BYTES via envsubst templating.

compose.description: Local-only infrastructure containers (Postgres/Redis/MinIO/migrate) that exist only in compose.production-parity.yml. No Terraform resource: GCP provisions Cloud SQL/Memorystore/GCS instead.

entries.name: BFF_UPSTREAM_IDENTITY_AUDIENCE
entries.validation: Only read when BFF_UPSTREAM_IDENTITY_MODE === 'metadata-server' (a capability flag, independent of NODE_ENV -- see BFF_UPSTREAM_IDENTITY_MODE). Falls back to API_ORIGIN when unset.

entries.name: BFF_UPSTREAM_IDENTITY_MODE
entries.validation: One of disabled|metadata-server. Required (fail-fast, no default) whenever NODE_ENV=production in apps/bff/src/config.ts's readBffConfig -- production-parity, staging and production must all explicitly declare this rather than silently defaulting to disabled, which would silently skip the Cloud Run identity-token hop. 'metadata-server' means the exact same CloudRunIdentityService code path (acquisition/caching/refresh/timeout/failure handling) runs everywhere -- production-parity points BFF_METADATA_IDENTITY_ENDPOINT at a local emulator (infra/production/identity-emulator/), staging/production at the real GCE metadata server.

entries.name: BFF_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.validation: Integer 100-30000, default 5000.

entries.name: DATABASE_CA_BASE64
entries.validation: Non-empty base64. Required whenever NODE_ENV=production in apps/api/src/production/config.ts and apps/worker/src/production/config.ts -- both fail fast without it, mirroring REDIS_CA_BASE64. Enforces TLS verification against Cloud SQL (ssl_mode=ENCRYPTED_ONLY in infra/terraform/main.tf) in staging/production, and against the local hostssl-only Postgres container in production-parity (see infra/postgres/init/00-enforce-tls.sh and compose.production-parity.yml's postgres-production service).

entries.validation: Optional; provider reports configuration_required until set alongside the client id.

entries.parityOnlyReason: MinIO root credential; GCS uses the Cloud Run service account identity instead of a root user/password.

entries.name: NODE_ENV
entries.validation: api/worker/bff: one of development|test|production (undefined/'local' maps to development for api/worker, to 'local' for bff). All three services always run the literal 'production' in production-parity, staging and production alike -- there is no BFF-specific override anymore. See BFF_UPSTREAM_IDENTITY_MODE for how the BFF's one genuinely environment-specific behavior (the Cloud Run identity-token hop) is now gated instead.

entries.validation: Required only when AI_PROVIDER=openai; never expose to browser, fixtures, logs or commits.

entries.name: OPENAI_TIMEOUT_MS
entries.validation: Positive integer timeout for one OpenAI Responses request.

entries.name: OPENAI_VERBOSITY
entries.validation: One of low, medium, high; invalid values fall back to medium.

entries.name: OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT
entries.validation: URL with protocol http:/https:.

entries.name: OTEL_SERVICE_NAME
entries.validation: Defaults to papadata-api when unset (process.env.OTEL_SERVICE_NAME ??= ...).

entries.name: PAPADATA_API_AUTH_ACTIVE_SECRET
entries.validation: At least 32 bytes; must differ from PAPADATA_API_AUTH_PREVIOUS_SECRET; must equal BFF_INTERNAL_AUTH_ACTIVE_SECRET.

entries.name: PAPADATA_API_AUTH_AUDIENCE
entries.validation: Non-empty string; must equal BFF_INTERNAL_AUTH_AUDIENCE.

entries.name: PAPADATA_API_AUTH_ISSUER
entries.validation: Non-empty string; must equal BFF_INTERNAL_AUTH_ISSUER.

entries.name: PAPADATA_API_AUTH_JWT_SECRET
entries.validation: Legacy alias consulted only when PAPADATA_API_AUTH_ACTIVE_SECRET is unset; do not configure both.

entries.name: PAPADATA_API_AUTH_PREVIOUS_SECRET
entries.validation: Optional; at least 32 bytes when set; must equal BFF_INTERNAL_AUTH_PREVIOUS_SECRET.

entries.name: PAPADATA_API_AUTH_SESSION_REDIS_PREFIX
entries.validation: Defaults to papadata:auth when unset.

entries.name: PAPADATA_API_AUTH_SESSION_STORE
entries.validation: 'redis-auth-state' required outside NODE_ENV=test; 'test-memory' only allowed when NODE_ENV=test.

entries.name: PAPADATA_API_QUEUE_DRIVER
entries.validation: Only 'test-memory' is recognized, and only takes effect when NODE_ENV=test. Must never be set in production-parity/staging/production.
entries.parityOnlyReason: Test-only in-memory escape hatch gated on NODE_ENV=test; production-parity/staging/production always run NODE_ENV=production, so this driver value can never activate there.

entries.name: PAPADATA_APP_PASSWORD
entries.validation: Non-empty random secret.
entries.parityOnlyReason: Local Compose credential primitive used only to synthesize DATABASE_URL/SCHEDULER_DATABASE_URL/REDIS_URL/storage credentials locally (see source.kind=template/reference entries that consume it). GCP provisions the equivalent as an opaque, ready-made Secret Manager connection string (database_url/scheduler_database_url/redis_url) and has no env var of this name.

entries.name: PAPADATA_ASSISTANT_RETENTION_ENABLED
entries.validation: Must be exactly 'true' to run the assistant retention sweep.

entries.name: PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_API_KEY
entries.validation: Resend provider API key; required only when enabled AND PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_TRANSPORT=resend (the default). Left empty for production-parity, which uses the smtp transport against a local Mailpit mailbox instead.

entries.name: PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_ENABLED
entries.validation: Must be exactly 'true' to enable auth-mail delivery. production-parity enables it against a local Mailpit mailbox (see PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_TRANSPORT); staging/production stay operator-controlled.

entries.name: PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_FROM
entries.validation: From-address; required when enabled.

entries.name: PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_KEY_BASE64
entries.validation: Base64-encoded, exactly 32 raw bytes; required when enabled. production-parity generates a fresh random key (never a fixed/committed secret).

entries.name: PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_SMTP_HOST
entries.validation: SMTP host; required when PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_TRANSPORT=smtp. production-parity points this at the local Mailpit service on the internal Compose network.
entries.parityOnlyReason: Only production-parity's local Mailpit-backed smtp transport uses this; staging/production keep the resend transport, which never reads it.

entries.name: PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_SMTP_PASSWORD
entries.validation: Optional SMTP password, paired with PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_SMTP_USER, for a real external SMTP relay. Left unset for production-parity's Mailpit, which accepts unauthenticated local connections.
entries.parityOnlyReason: Only meaningful for the smtp transport, itself production-parity-only; see PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_SMTP_HOST.

entries.name: PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_SMTP_PORT
entries.validation: SMTP port; required when PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_TRANSPORT=smtp. 1025 is Mailpit's default SMTP port on the internal Compose network.
entries.parityOnlyReason: Only production-parity's local Mailpit-backed smtp transport uses this; staging/production keep the resend transport, which never reads it.

entries.name: PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_SMTP_SECURE
entries.validation: Optional; 'true' enables implicit TLS. Mailpit's local SMTP listener is plaintext, so production-parity sets this to false. Absent/anything else is treated as false.
entries.parityOnlyReason: Only meaningful for the smtp transport, itself production-parity-only; see PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_SMTP_HOST.

entries.name: PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_SMTP_USER
entries.validation: Optional SMTP username for a real external SMTP relay; absent means no SMTP auth. Left unset for production-parity's Mailpit, which needs none.
entries.parityOnlyReason: Only meaningful for the smtp transport, itself production-parity-only; see PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_SMTP_HOST.

entries.name: PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_TRANSPORT
entries.validation: One of resend|smtp. Empty/absent defaults to resend (today's behavior everywhere this var isn't set, unaffected by this entry). production-parity sets this to smtp for the local Mailpit mailbox; staging/production never set it and keep resend.
entries.parityOnlyReason: production-parity is the only environment that overrides the transport away from the resend default.

entries.name: PAPADATA_BILLING_ALLOW_LIVE
entries.validation: Must be 'true' for PAPADATA_BILLING_MODE=live to be accepted; otherwise live mode throws.

entries.name: PAPADATA_BILLING_MODE
entries.validation: 'test' or 'live' activates billing; anything else keeps it null.

entries.name: PAPADATA_BILLING_PRICES_JSON
entries.validation: JSON array; defaults to [] when unset.

entries.name: PAPADATA_BILLING_RETURN_ORIGIN
entries.validation: URL origin billing checkout/portal redirects back to.

entries.name: PAPADATA_COOKIE_CONSENT_VERSION
entries.validation: Required, non-empty, max 80 chars. Bump when cookie policy changes so stale decisions require renewed consent.

entries.name: PAPADATA_INFRASTRUCTURE_AUTH_TOKEN
entries.validation: At least 32 bytes; must not match the placeholder pattern.

entries.name: PAPADATA_INTEGRATION_SECRET_LOCATION
entries.validation: GCP region-shaped string (e.g. europe-west1); required together with _PROJECT and _WRITE_ENABLED=true.

entries.name: PAPADATA_INTEGRATION_SECRET_PROJECT
entries.validation: GCP project id (lowercase, 6-63 chars); required together with _LOCATION and _WRITE_ENABLED=true.

entries.name: PAPADATA_INTEGRATION_SECRET_WRITE_ENABLED
entries.validation: Must be exactly 'true' to enable Secret Manager provisioning; otherwise provisioning throws.

entries.name: PAPADATA_PAPA_REMOTE_ALLOWED_HOSTS
entries.validation: Comma-separated allowlist the endpoint host must appear in.

entries.name: PAPADATA_PAPA_REMOTE_API_KEY
entries.validation: Required when the remote provider is enabled.

entries.name: PAPADATA_PAPA_REMOTE_ENABLED
entries.validation: 'true' to enable; anything else disables the remote provider.

entries.name: PAPADATA_PAPA_REMOTE_ENDPOINT
entries.validation: Required (with host in PAPADATA_PAPA_REMOTE_ALLOWED_HOSTS) when enabled.

entries.name: PAPADATA_PAPA_REMOTE_MODEL
entries.validation: Required when the remote provider is enabled.

entries.name: PAPADATA_PAPA_REMOTE_RESERVE_MINOR_PER_CALL
entries.validation: Positive integer (minor currency units), default 50.

entries.name: PAPADATA_PLATFORM_PASSWORD
entries.validation: Non-empty random secret.
entries.parityOnlyReason: Local Compose credential primitive used only to synthesize DATABASE_URL/SCHEDULER_DATABASE_URL/REDIS_URL/storage credentials locally (see source.kind=template/reference entries that consume it). GCP provisions the equivalent as an opaque, ready-made Secret Manager connection string (database_url/scheduler_database_url/redis_url) and has no env var of this name.

entries.name: PAPADATA_PRIVACY_URL
entries.validation: Must be an https: URL with no userinfo when set.

entries.name: PAPADATA_PRIVACY_VERSION
entries.validation: Both _VERSION and _URL must be set together (https:, no embedded credentials, version <=80 chars) or the document is silently omitted.

entries.name: PAPADATA_STORAGE_ACCESS_KEY
entries.validation: Required when PAPADATA_STORAGE_DRIVER=minio; must be absent when driver=gcs.
entries.parityOnlyReason: MinIO credential; GCS uses the Cloud Run service account identity instead.

entries.name: PAPADATA_STORAGE_BUCKET
entries.validation: Non-empty string.

entries.name: PAPADATA_STORAGE_DRIVER
entries.validation: One of minio|gcs. Required (no default) once NODE_ENV=production.
entries.productionOnlyReason: production-parity emulates GCS with MinIO per the LP-6 parity matrix (objectStorage: emulated).

entries.name: PAPADATA_STORAGE_ENDPOINT
entries.validation: Required (non-empty) when PAPADATA_STORAGE_DRIVER=minio; must be absent when driver=gcs.
entries.parityOnlyReason: MinIO (S3-compatible emulator) needs an explicit endpoint URL; GCS does not.

entries.name: PAPADATA_STORAGE_SECRET_KEY
entries.validation: Required when PAPADATA_STORAGE_DRIVER=minio; must be absent when driver=gcs.
entries.parityOnlyReason: MinIO credential; GCS uses the Cloud Run service account identity instead.

entries.name: PAPADATA_TERMS_URL
entries.validation: Must be an https: URL with no userinfo when set.

entries.name: PAPADATA_TERMS_VERSION
entries.validation: Both _VERSION and _URL must be set together (https:, no embedded credentials, version <=80 chars) or the document is silently omitted.

entries.name: PAPADATA_TEST_PASSWORD
entries.validation: Non-empty random secret.
entries.parityOnlyReason: Local Compose credential primitive used only to synthesize DATABASE_URL/SCHEDULER_DATABASE_URL/REDIS_URL/storage credentials locally (see source.kind=template/reference entries that consume it). GCP provisions the equivalent as an opaque, ready-made Secret Manager connection string (database_url/scheduler_database_url/redis_url) and has no env var of this name.

entries.name: PAPADATA_WEB_ORIGIN
entries.validation: Not fail-fast in dev or when mail is disabled: oauth-provider.config.ts treats an unset/invalid value as null and OAuth just reports configuration_required. Truly required (throws) whenever PAPADATA_AUTH_MAIL_ENABLED=true -- true for production-parity (Mailpit-backed local verification/reset mail) and whenever an operator enables mail in staging/production. Terraform always sets it in staging/production regardless.
